_note: organisations-role-mapping-and-access-review: the Access review page, a child of Organisations. A custom page because it renders the organisation-scoped GET /api/access-review/{organisationUuid} answer (roles with their sources, last sign-in, review state) and its Keep access, Remove role and Disable account actions; no index type expresses per-row decisions over a derived, non-object list. The entry carries permission access.review, which the shell's permission list grants to Nextcloud admins and functional administrators.

pages.title: Access review
pages._note: One row per person with an account: roles and where each comes from, last sign-in, account status, when and by whom access was last reviewed, and whether a review is due. The server answers Nextcloud admins for any organisation and functional administrators for their own, and refuses others.
